decisions.decision: Add Comment.author.handle and PullRequestInfo.authorHandle; keep author/name as display text
decisions.why: Replacing author with the handle would show raw Bitbucket account ids on Home and in search

decisions.decision: One core sameHandle helper: non-empty, case-insensitive, used in all five identity checks
decisions.why: GitHub/GitLab handles ignore case; empty never matching covers deleted author accounts

decisions.decision: Comment.startsThread flag; UI threadsOf shows a Deleted comment placeholder when a thread has no start
decisions.why: id === threadId cannot mark the start on GitLab, whose thread id is a discussion id
decisions.rejected: Adapters emit a synthetic deleted root

decisions.decision: Decision outcome carries message {posted, commentId|reason}; core writes a <requestId>:message comment record; result carries warning message_not_posted
decisions.why: Reuses existing write_record actions with no schema change and makes the message editable

decisions.decision: Request-scoped GET memo via AsyncLocalStorage in the read layer, cleared by any write, scope opened per server request
decisions.why: Exactly one request, no TTL guess, no contract change, helps all platforms
decisions.rejected: Short-TTL cache inside the Bitbucket adapter

decisions.decision: Shared approvedAcross helper in src/adapters/; read contract approvedByMe shape unchanged
decisions.why: Lifts Bitbucket logging/unavailable behaviour to all three without touching core
decisions.rejected: Per-PR contract method with the loop in core

decisions.decision: GitHub reply to a whole-PR comment: read pulls/comments, on not_found post a quoting issue comment
decisions.why: Mirrors the existing edit fallback and uses an allowlisted endpoint

decisions.decision: Optional neutral workspace.sshHost config for GitLab; GitHub accepts ssh.github.com
decisions.why: GitLab SSH host is unknowable before discovery and repositoryForRemote is synchronous
decisions.rejected: Accept any host whose path matches

decisions.decision: Spec context: branch-name terms when no tracker key, ls-remote --symref for default branch, keep stored rule value and relabel
decisions.why: Implements FR-032..035 without a store migration

decisions.decision: Markdown preview exemption named in ui-safety; existing Playwright test proves sanitising
decisions.why: DOMPurify needs a DOM; adding jsdom breaks Q.1 minimum
decisions.rejected: Add jsdom as a dev dependency

decisions.decision: Recording by a person-run test/record script with account aliasing; GitLab from the local instance
decisions.why: XI.5 forbids automated tests against hosted platforms; aliases keep account details out

decisions.decision: Record hosted review-action fixtures through the real UI with a test-only node --import capture preload (test/record/capture.ts), not a script driving writer adapters
decisions.why: A script writing to hosted Bitbucket/GitHub through an adapter breaks XI.4, and writes not started by a UI click break II.4; the preload keeps recording code out of the product
decisions.rejected: Constitution amendment; plan-level exception; dropping hosted recording

decisions.decision: Read memo key is URL plus authorization plus accept; the body is read once and replayed as a fresh Response
decisions.why: the same URL answers differently by Accept (JSON vs diff) and a Response body can be read once
decisions.rejected: keying on URL and credential only, which broke the platform-diff fallback

decisions.decision: Bitbucket approve and request-changes keep the {commit} body
decisions.why: the shared approve-on-commit test needs a write carrying the commit
decisions.rejected: dropping the body as the task text says
